_comment: Recorded baseline for the LLM router, 2026-09-07.
Measured against gpt-5.4-mini on this corpus and this probe set — both
are named below, because the numbers mean nothing without them.
The three misses are recorded rather than tagged away: each is
defensible model behaviour, and a harness tuned until it passes
measures the tagger rather than the system.
OBSERVED RANGE, not a fixed number: two consecutive runs of the same
probe set against the same model gave language 0.983 and 0.966. The
call is temperature 0, so this is provider-side nondeterminism, not a
code change. That is why the thresholds sit at 0.95 / 0.85 rather than
at the measured value -- a threshold pinned to a lucky run fails on the
next one and teaches everyone to ignore the check.
